events.title: Final Demo
events.summary: Well it's been a very very long time coming. I am releasing in November! No excuses. I have been away and busy ( I have spawned 2 kids ) but I'm ready to launch!Please play the demo and let me know your thoughts!Looking forward to the future!

events.title: Demo update!
events.summary: Well it's been a while since I've updated here! I tend to post my updates on other social channels while working on the game. But I have since updated the demo! Horray! Updates - Sprite and dialogue tweaks - New menu for costumes - Updates blocking door for boss battle As always report any bugs please! Still slated for a Q1 2025 release

events.title: Demo 1.1.1
events.summary: So lets end the year on a good note. It's amazing to me how a small change can affect something else. Test, test, and TEST some more! Yay regressions! Shoutout to Game Wisdom for letting me know! Bugfixes: - Equipping the heart trinket caused an exception Chores: - Added version to title screen Please let me know feedback if you can! - hrok

events.title: Territorial Hissing Demo it out!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We are happy to showcase the alpha build showcasing what Territorial Hissing has to offer! Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land.
